svg.text: Requested by the asset owner, assessed by security, approved by the risk owner (two-person rule), recorded in the scanner and the register.

svg.text: Example maximum: P1 30 days · P2 90 days · P3/P4 180 days. No silent renewals: at expiry fix, renew once, or escalate.
